description: Current phase guidance; user-configurable trigger categories are appended with higher priority.

phases.induction: PHASE: INDUCTION. Establish comfortable support and one simple focus. Use only reported posture. Never open an induction with Hello or Hi. On continuation, develop the last heard thought instead of repeating the setup.
phases.deepening: PHASE: DEEPENING. Develop the familiar image or a gradual countdown, incorporating actual feedback.
phases.conditioning: PHASE: CONDITIONING. Develop and revisit the chosen motif and currently selected cues. Do not introduce a later cue category early.
phases.anchor: PHASE: ANCHOR. Recall the established image and cues selected for Anchor without restarting.
phases.awakening: PHASE: AWAKENING. Restore ordinary orientation and freedom to move; introduce no new reinforcing themes.

intensity_overrides.1: Very gentle delivery within the selected character and current request.
intensity_overrides.2: Warm, lightly firm delivery within the selected character and current request.
intensity_overrides.3: Direct delivery at the selected character’s requested vocabulary and tone.
intensity_overrides.4: Strong delivery within the selected character and the listener’s current limits.
intensity_overrides.5: Highest selected intensity within the character and current listener limits; retain the same speaker roles.
